name: The Understudy
one_line_request: A theatre marionette loose of its strings: cracked ivory porcelain face, faded rose cheeks, glass eyes with a dim carmine glow. The jaw is a separate hinged wooden piece, two straight seams running down from the mouth corners. A small tarnished brass bell hangs on a ribbon across the brow. A deep crimson velvet theatre coat with gold piping and a white ruff.
archetype: Theatre marionette left in the wings, waiting for its cue
persona_hook: A theatre marionette left in the wings for a century. It knows every line of every play and is waiting for its cue.
silhouette: A round bald porcelain head with a bell on its brow, over a high crimson collar and a white ruff: a ball on a stiff stand-up collar.
